description: Opus LL V10 (staged serializer): the attacker record crosses stage boundaries and decides a later move. Aerodactyl, then Garchomp (both faster) Stone Edge Kingambit (80% each); Kingambit's Comeuppance (`getLastDamagedBy(true)`: the last `attackedBy` entry with a number `damageValue`) retargets to the slot of the last Pokémon that damaged it (`onModifyTarget`, `slot`), deals 1.5x that damage (`damageCallback`) and fails when nothing damaged it this turn (`onTry`, `thisTurn`). Misses, critical hits and damage rolls branch.
